hero.title: Specialist attorneys for land, property and development
hero.lead: Since 1990 we have worked in conveyancing, planning, environmental and land-legal matters for developers, communities and government, from offices in Durban and Cape Town.

practice.title: Thirteen disciplines, four areas of practice
practice.text: Organised the way a development moves: from the ground, through approval, to transfer and beyond. Choose an area to see the work within it.

firm.title: The legal work between land and development
firm.text: HSG was established in 1990 as South Africa’s first specialist environmental law firm. We work alongside clients and built-environment specialists through the whole property-development process: land identification and tenure, planning and environmental approval, and registered transfer.
firm.imageAlt: HSG directors reviewing a site development plan
firm.imageHint: Move over the photo to see it in colour

appointments.title: Work entrusted to the firm since 1994
appointments.text: Property portfolios, land-legal teams and development projects for government, communities and private clients.

people.title: Directors lead each matter
people.text: Supported by associates, candidate attorneys, conveyancing secretaries and a property-administration team of more than sixty.
